name: @lango-project/lango-api
description: HTTP API host for Lango applications.

scripts.build: lango build src/cli.lango --out dist/cli.mjs --executable && lango build src/tokens.lango --out dist/tokens.mjs && lango build src/worker_host.lango --out dist/worker_host.mjs && lango build src/worker_entry.lango --out dist/worker_entry.mjs
scripts.test: lango test src/cli.lango --build-dir .test-output/source && npm run test:tokens && npm run test:runtime && npm run test:state && npm run test:worker-host && npm run test:resilience
scripts.test:tokens: lango build src/tokens_test.lango --out .test-output/tokens_test.mjs --executable && node .test-output/tokens_test.mjs && lango build src/session_lifetime_test.lango --out .test-output/session_lifetime_test.mjs --executable && node .test-output/session_lifetime_test.mjs && lango build src/sync_tokens_test.lango --out .test-output/sync_tokens_test.mjs --executable && node .test-output/sync_tokens_test.mjs
scripts.test:workers: npm run build && npm run test:http-support && lango build ../lango-ui/src/library.lango --out ../lango-ui/dist/library.mjs && lango build src/worker_fixture.lango --out .test-output/worker_fixture.mjs && lango build src/worker_http_test.lango --out .test-output/worker_http_test.mjs --executable && node .test-output/worker_http_test.mjs && npm run test:worker-ui
scripts.build:worker-demo: npm run build && lango build examples/worker-app.lango --out dist/worker-demo-app.mjs && lango build examples/worker-server.lango --out dist/worker-demo-server.mjs --executable
scripts.test:worker-host: npm run test:http-support && lango build src/cli.lango --out .test-output/worker-cli.mjs --executable && lango build src/worker_entry.lango --out .test-output/worker_entry.mjs && lango build src/worker_config_fixture.lango --out .test-output/worker_config_fixture.mjs && lango build src/worker_xml_fixture.lango --out .test-output/worker_xml_fixture.mjs && lango build src/worker_host_test.lango --out .test-output/worker_host_test.mjs --executable && node .test-output/worker_host_test.mjs && lango build src/worker_xml_test.lango --out .test-output/worker_xml_test.mjs --executable && node .test-output/worker_xml_test.mjs && npm run test:worker-events
scripts.test:worker-events: lango build src/worker_entry.lango --out .test-output/worker_entry.mjs && lango build src/worker_events_fixture.lango --out .test-output/worker_events_fixture.mjs && lango build src/worker_events_test.lango --out .test-output/worker_events_test.mjs --executable && node .test-output/worker_events_test.mjs
scripts.test:worker-ui: lango build src/worker_entry.lango --out .test-output/worker_entry.mjs && lango build src/worker_ui_app.lango --out .test-output/worker_ui_app.mjs && lango build src/worker_ui_fixture.lango --out .test-output/worker_ui_fixture.mjs && lango build src/worker_ui_test.lango --out .test-output/worker_ui_test.mjs --executable && node .test-output/worker_ui_test.mjs
scripts.test:http-support: lango build src/http_test_server.lango --out .test-output/http_test_server.mjs --executable && lango build src/http_test_client.lango --out .test-output/http_test_client.mjs --executable
scripts.test:resilience: npm run test:http-support && lango build src/worker_entry.lango --out .test-output/worker_entry.mjs && lango build src/resilience_fixture.lango --out .test-output/resilience_fixture.mjs && lango build src/resilience_test.lango --out .test-output/resilience_test.mjs --executable && node .test-output/resilience_test.mjs
scripts.bench:workers: npm run test:http-support && lango build src/worker_entry.lango --out .test-output/worker_entry.mjs && lango build src/load_fixture.lango --out .test-output/load_fixture.mjs && lango build src/load_client.lango --out .test-output/load_client.mjs --executable && lango build src/load_workers.lango --out .test-output/load_workers.mjs --executable && node .test-output/load_workers.mjs
